GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 17 January 2026
Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island.
There is a possibility of ground frost at some places in Nuwara-Eliya district in the early hours of
the morning.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-
western, North-central and Uva provinces and in Galle, Matara and Ampara districts during the
early hours of the morning.
